correctness.rationale: The assigned RESULT.md fixes 24 signed long-axis vertices, a 48-edge degree-four graph and shortest-path distance, inclusive at scales 1 and 2. Fresh code independently enumerated 8 triangles, 18 induced squares, 638 faces of Cl(G²) with f=(24,132,248,186,48), and a 134-face K with f=(24,66,44). It verified cyclic vertex links, each edge in exactly two triangles, connectivity and Euler characteristic 2; thus K is a closed connected 2-manifold homeomorphic to S². An independent greedy algorithm, not the bundled verifier, found 252 successive free-face collapses outside K ending EXACTLY at K; additionally a separate read-only JavaScript check replayed every one of the 252 actual ordered pairs from pinned collapse_certificate.json and independently confirmed each unique coface, and exact final face-set equality. Sympy exact arithmetic verified all 26 indicated supporting facet planes with the graph-cycle facet sets: eight triangular faces, six coordinate squares, twelve pair squares. At scale 1 the eight disjoint triangle simplices are free-collapsed to a connected 24-vertex, 40-edge graph with cycle rank 17. Consequently H1→H1(S²) is zero and H2 at scale 2 has rank one. Finite enumeration is exhaustive for the precisely finite claim.
residual_risks: Result asserts no minimum collapse count; exactly 252 is this witness, not a lower bound.
No analysis of thresholds >=3, other Archimedean solids, or Euclidean vertex-metric Rips; complex is graph shortest-path.
Independent script has only been run on this finite specified graph, not arbitrary graphs.

The exact combinatorial flag complex is four-dimensional yet has an explicit simple collapse onto the actual embedded polyhedral boundary, a stronger conclusion than computing a Betti table or merely abstract S² type. The threshold-1 wedge of 17 circles and threshold-2 2-sphere isolate a nontrivial graph-metric topological transition with reproducible precise integral information. This is a motivated natural finite invariant and a substantive fixed-complex collapse; no general theorem or paper-sized advance is required.
residual_risks: This is one 24-vertex example, not a classification of Archimedean solids or complete persistent homology.
